title: Drones Helping People
subtitle: Drone-based mapping, field education, and community-engaged research at Columbia University
method: Source-based descriptions of field activities and derived spatial products
language_principles: Name the observed or derived object and its method.
Distinguish source observations, processing outputs, interpretation, intended application, and planned work.
Report units, denominators, spatial coverage, dates, and processing-run identity where relevant.
Keep pixel size and internal processing measures distinct from independent accuracy.
Describe unresolved causes and outcomes without implying validation.
Retain source-specific limitations at the relevant product or methods entry rather than repeating general disclaimers.
hosting: Public GitHub Pages preview from a site-only repository; development records remain private.
source_review: Local archives, supplied Google Drive folder, and authenticated Site Scan mission records reviewed for a more balanced New York teaching and community-fieldwork edition.
